description: Explicit Translation generation operations: current queued and running jobs, applied, failed, and cancelled terminal log outcomes, request actions, committed command enqueue, Translation-to-OG handoff outcomes, and authoritative OG terminal outcomes. Target-locale documents are not aggregated into a separate operational lifecycle, and source edits never enqueue generation automatically.

panels.description: Translation PGMQ commands committed with newly requested jobs in the selected range. Queue delivery retries remain Queue Operations telemetry and do not create another product job.
panels.title: Translation Commands Queued

panels.description: Applied outcomes from the single Translation terminal event in the selected range. A retry of the same job is a separate execution outcome.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome="applied" | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Applied Outcomes

panels.description: Failed outcomes from the single Translation terminal event in the selected range. Cancelled outcomes are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome="failed" | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` | error_classification=~`${error_classification:regex}` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed Outcomes

panels.description: Applied outcomes divided by applied plus failed outcomes from the single Translation terminal event. Cancelled outcomes are excluded from the ratio.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome="applied" | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome=~`applied|failed` | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Apply Ratio

panels.description: Current in-flight Translation jobs grouped only by their persisted queued or running execution status. Terminal results are deleted from this table and observed from terminal log telemetry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT entity_type AS "Entity type",
       target_locale AS "Target locale",
       status AS "Status",
       COUNT(*) AS "Active jobs"
FROM translation_job
WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')
  AND entity_type IN (${entity_type:sqlstring})
  AND target_locale IN (${target_locale:sqlstring})
GROUP BY entity_type, target_locale, status
ORDER BY entity_type, target_locale, status;

panels.title: Active Translation Jobs

panels.description: Translation jobs queued per second by target locale.
panels.title: Queued Jobs by Locale

panels.description: Applied, failed, and cancelled results from the single Translation terminal event. Cancelled is an outcome, not a failure.
panels.title: Terminal Outcomes

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome=~`applied|failed|cancelled` | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Failed outcomes from the single Translation terminal event, grouped by the shared nine-value error classification catalog. Cancelled outcomes and raw provider errors, bodies, XLIFF, text, and document handles are excluded.
panels.title: Failed Jobs

targets.expr: sum by (error_classification) (count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome="failed" | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` | error_classification=~`${error_classification:regex}` [$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: p95 end-to-end duration from the single Translation terminal log event, grouped by applied, failed, and cancelled outcome.
panels.title: Job Duration (p95)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome=~`applied|failed|cancelled` | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__rate_interval]) by (outcome)

panels.description: Applied outcomes divided by applied plus failed outcomes from the single Translation terminal event. Cancelled outcomes are excluded.
panels.title: Apply Success Ratio

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome="applied" | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", domain="translation"} | json event="body.event", job_id="body.job_id", entity_type="body.entity_type", target_locale="body.target_locale", outcome="body.outcome", duration_ms="body.duration_ms", error_classification="body.error_classification" | event="translation.job.terminal" | outcome=~`applied|failed` | entity_type=~`${entity_type:regex}` | target_locale=~`${target_locale:regex}` [$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.description: Explicit generation request, retry, and active-job cancel actions by authorized owning-domain editors, grouped by bounded action and outcome. A retry creates a new job from the current source.
panels.title: Explicit Translation Requests

panels.description: Rate of the exact Translation provider client spans by operation and OpenTelemetry status. Provider handles, keys, XLIFF, bodies, and raw errors are excluded from span names and attributes.
panels.title: Provider Upload / Poll / Download Spans

panels.description: Authoritative OG terminal outcomes from the OG service. This existing signal has no locale label, so it proves OG completion and bounded failure without inventing a Translation-localized correlation.
panels.title: OG Terminal Outcomes

targets.expr: sum by (event) (rate({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", service_name="geul-og"} | json event="body.event", job_kind="body.job_kind" | event=~`job\.(succeeded|failed)` | job_kind="og_generation" [$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Authoritative OG job.failed records grouped only by the bounded OG failure catalog. Queue retry and requeue records are intentionally excluded from product failure.
panels.title: OG Terminal Failures

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate({service_namespace="geul", deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}", exporter="otlp", retention_class="application", service_name="geul-og"} | json event="body.event", job_kind="body.job_kind", reason="body.reason" | event="job.failed" | job_kind="og_generation" | reason=~`invalid_claim|source_rejected|processing_failed|integrity_failed|completion_rejected` [$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Applied Translation-to-OG request handoff outcomes at the owning transaction boundary. committed means the OG request was durably committed; failed records og_handoff_failed as the Translation terminal error classification. IDs are intentionally absent.
panels.title: Translation to OG Handoff
